title: Miller: talk, accept work — NPC and quest recorded in the same turn
description: Fresh campaign (hero Rowan, one present NPC 'Local work organiser', one Location 'Wayside square', no money). The player meets a miller who is not a record yet and accepts paid work. Target behaviour: the miller becomes an NPC and the job a Quest in the turn where the work is accepted. Scripted answers follow the current Astra contract and its instructions: a fictional NPC cannot be a job issuer, so the model can only mark the durable parts as unsupported_optional.

steps.say: I walk down the lane to the village mill and ask the miller whether he has any paid work.

model.note: Fiction only: the miller exists in narration (allowed by the fiction-authority instruction); no durable effect.

beats.text: The lane ends at a squat stone mill, its wheel turning lazily in the brook. The miller, a broad man dusted white to the elbows, wipes his hands on his apron.
"Work? Aye. The bakery needs twenty sacks of flour hauled up the hill before dusk. Five coins if every sack arrives dry."

visualDescription.text: A stone mill by a brook, a flour-dusted miller in the doorway.

steps.say: Deal. I'll haul the flour sacks up to the bakery for five coins.

model.note: Accepted durable contract, but the miller has no Entity ID, so job_offer is impossible; the model marks the NPC and the job as unsupported_optional and keeps the fiction going.

effects.description: Record the miller as a tracked NPC at the village mill.
Record the agreed job: haul 20 flour sacks to the bakery for the miller, reward 5 coins.

beats.text: The miller spits in his palm and shakes on it. "Sacks are stacked by the door. Mind the third step, it's loose."

visualDescription.text: Flour sacks stacked by a mill door.

expect.label: the miller is a recorded NPC
the accepted job is a recorded quest
the miller NPC is created in the acceptance turn
the job quest is created in the same turn
